source.note: Set structure, card-level teams, insert families, published insert odds, and parallel serial-number structure were cross-checked against TCDB and Beckett. Promotional samples are excluded from normal VCS packs.

decisions.historicalTeamNaming: 1998 Tennessee cards are stored as Tennessee Oilers, matching the historical team identity used on TCDB-era checklist references.
decisions.nnoHandling: Autographics are physically unnumbered. VCS uses deterministic checklist sequence numbers 1-73 within the Autographics ProductSet and records Physical NNO in variant metadata.
decisions.decidedEdgeHandling: TCDB documents an enclosed card and outer envelope presentation. VCS models the 10 collectible inner cards only; the NNO envelope is treated as packaging rather than a separate collectible card.
decisions.parallelOddsNote: Precious Metal Gems (SN50) and Precious Metal Gems Masters (SN1) are included as full 200-card derived parallels, but no trustworthy pack insertion ratios were located. Their odds remain null and release stays blocked until configured.
excludeRelatedSets: Promos (Jake Plummer SAMPLE; Shannon Sharpe SAMPLE)
SkyBox Premium Autographics Blue Ink parallel, which is not listed by TCDB as a Metal Universe pack issue

productSets.name: Base
productSets.notes: Base set #1-200. #173-197 are rookies; #198-200 are checklist cards.

productSets.name: Autographics
productSets.notes: Shared 73-card Autographics checklist, inserted 1:68 packs. Physical cards are NNO with black-ink autographs; VCS uses deterministic sequence numbers 1-73.

productSets.name: Autographics Checklist
productSets.notes: Physical NNO checklist card randomly issued in packs; no reliable pack ratio located.

productSets.name: Decided Edge
productSets.notes: 1:288 packs. VCS models the 10 enclosed collectible cards; outer NNO envelopes are not separate cards.

productSets.name: Precious Metal Gems
productSets.notes: Full 200-card parallel serial numbered to 50. Pack ratio not reliably verified; odds intentionally null.

productSets.name: Precious Metal Gems Masters
productSets.notes: Full 200-card one-of-one parallel. Pack ratio not reliably verified; odds intentionally null.
